channel.title: Houston Public Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Houston Public Media (houstonpublicmedia.org)

item.title: Black drivers in Fort Bend County were stopped nearly twice as often as white drivers in 2025, report shows
item.description: Demographic data from the U.S. Census Bureau shows that nearly 28% of the county population is white, 25% of residents are Hispanic or Latino, a little more than 23% are Asian and a little less than 23% are Black.

item.title: Spouse of Texas pilot killed in UPS plane crash in Kentucky sues Boeing and GE
item.description: According to the lawsuit, as the aircraft took off, the left engine separated from the wing and ignited a fire.

item.title: Beyonce’s mother’s gumbo at the rodeo: The Good, Bad, and Ugly of the week
item.description: The Houston Matters panel of non-experts weighs in on stories from the week’s news and decides if they’re good, bad, or ugly.

item.title: Kamala Harris makes last-minute pitch for Jasmine Crockett with robocall
item.description: Harris has only gotten involved in two other primaries since 2024, both also involving friends with whom she has worked on the campaign or in the White House.

item.title: Bonck, deZevallos and Pratt lead crowded GOP field vying to succeed Hunt in TX-38
item.description: Texas’ 38th Congressional District was drawn with U.S. Rep. Wesley Hunt in mind. He's vacating the Houston-area seat to run for U.S. Senate.

item.title: Mayor Whitmire wants to ‘end homelessness’ in Houston this year. The effort faces challenges
item.description: There was a substantial shortfall in Whitmire's fundraising goal, and criminal enforcement has outpaced housing and service referrals

item.title: Data: Where is Houston Police Department ramping up citations of homeless people?
item.description: Criminal enforcement of sidewalk rules has outpaced referrals to services and housing.

item.title: Trump announces ‘major combat operations’ in Iran
item.description: Israel and the U.S. have launched strikes against Iran, with explosions reported in Tehran and air raid sirens sounding across Israel.
